one_sentence_story: Seligman and Maier proved in 1967 that identical stress causes giving-up ONLY when you have no working off-switch — and fifty years later discovered that passivity is an ancient brainstem reflex while active control is what your frontal lobe learns to unlock.
so_what_for_you: When big problems feel uncontrollable, stop staring at the immovable wall; engineer immediate small wins you directly control so your prefrontal cortex flips its mastery brake back on.
